Differences to check: The official access page lists Silver Gore at Chalk and Evelyn Gray at Green Door Store; neither has a Saturday time on Clashfinder. Its Chalk list also differs from the community list. Plantoid and Speedial each appear at two community venues. Both sets are shown; please verify. No missing times have been estimated.

Spotify buttons open a search for the act, so you can choose the right artist. Club-night listening links search Beastie Boys. Artist profiles are linked from the festival lineup where available. Some newer acts have no verified biography here yet.

Chalk, Green Door Store and Daltons are the venues the festival identifies as suitable for wheelchair access. Read the official accessibility information for details. Saved acts stay in this browser; My Schedule highlights overlapping sets and estimates walking times. Walking estimates exclude queues; check the linked route before travelling.
